ideas.title: Check your pantry before you bake: flour and ground cinnamon recalls, including lead in cinnamon again
ideas.angle: One service item that bundles both recalls ahead of holiday baking: which products, what to do with them. The take is that lead in ground cinnamon keeps coming back as a problem.
ideas.why_now: The cinnamon recall was reported 10/30 and the flour recall in October, just as November baking starts.
ideas.is_it_real: Both recalls exist but each comes from a single source (thehealthy.com, KLTV). Verify the hazard class and lot/UPC details in FDA enforcement reports. Don't call cinnamon a recurring issue without citing past FDA actions.

ideas.title: Pew: Americans are open to AI in healthcare, but want a human making the final call
ideas.angle: A short item with a take: people say they want a human making the final call, yet AI is already in their chart notes and insurance decisions. Pairs with the 'AI beats doctors' test issue.
ideas.is_it_real: Solid primary source. It is opinion data only, so it can't be used to say anything about whether AI tools are accurate.

ideas.title: Amlodipine recall: what blood pressure patients should check, and why you shouldn't just stop taking it
ideas.angle: Amlodipine is one of the most-prescribed blood pressure drugs. The useful take is how to check whether your bottle's maker and lot are affected, and why stopping a BP med cold is riskier than the recall.
ideas.why_now: Searches spiked 10/31 on the public-health radar.
ideas.is_it_real: Search spike only; no news context or source came with it. The manufacturer, lot numbers, recall class and reason must be confirmed in FDA enforcement reports before writing. If no current recall exists, drop it.

ideas.title: Kona Ice nutrition: how much sugar is in a shaved ice cup, and what's in the 'flavorwave' syrups
ideas.angle: An evergreen page answering what parents actually search: sugar and calories by cup size, what's in the syrups, and how it compares with other school-event treats.
ideas.why_now: Steady rising signal over 8 weeks, tied to Kona Ice trucks at school and sports events.
ideas.is_it_real: Search demand looks durable but modest. Nutrition figures must come from Kona Ice's own published info. The story hook is weak, so this is SEO only.
